display_long_description:
Imagine a performer stepping out of the screen and into your room — at full scale, in full motion, with every detail captured in stunning clarity. That's Vivid 4D.

Powered by 4D Gaussian Splatting — the most advanced volumetric video technology available — Vivid 4D renders real humans with photorealistic skin, fluid movement, and dynamic lighting. This isn't animation. This isn't CGI. This is a real person, replayed in your space.

Walk around them. Get close. Change your angle. With full 6DoF freedom, you're not watching a performance — you're sharing the room with it.

Key Features:

Life-Sized Performers in Your Room
Real dancers and performers at 1:1 scale, standing right in front of you. Every movement, every detail — exactly as if they were there.

4DGS Ultra-Realistic Quality
Photorealistic skin, hair, fabric, and motion captured and rendered in real-time. The clearest, most lifelike volumetric humans on any MR headset.

Walk Around the Performance
6DoF freedom means you move, they stay. Circle them, crouch down, lean in — every angle is yours to explore.

Free During Early Access
Our full library of premium 4D performances is completely free right now. Download before it changes.

Download Vivid 4D and step inside the performance.
